argmax.description: The accepted serial select_token operation, including its existing prompt copy. Inputs: input0 contiguous CUDA int64 prompt vector; input1 contiguous CUDA BF16 nonempty score vector; input2 int decode_steps=1. Both vectors share the selected device and their lengths fit int32. The schedule supplies the actual final-row logits through a contiguous view, never recorded scores during reconstruction. Returns fresh int64 tokens[1,prompt_length+1] and rank-zero int64 selected index. Copy prompt first, initialize best/index from score 0, then visit columns 1..N-1 in order. Update only for value>best or isnan(value)&&!isnan(best): the first equal maximum wins, signed-zero ties retain the first index, and the first NaN wins over finite values and later NaNs. No running maximum is merged or reordered. This is a separate argmax proof target: exact replay does not establish stability between approximately related upstream scores or cross-implementation numerical/compositional equivalence.

decoder.description: One complete accepted eight-kernel decoder block, reused for all 28 layers: QKV projection, Q/K RMS and RoPE, causal grouped-query attention, output projection, attention residual/post-attention RMS, gate/up projection, SiLU product, down projection, and final residual/following RMS. Inputs: input0 flat CUDA BF16 packed weights; input1 residual[7,1024]; input2 already normalized[7,1024]; input3 rotary[2,7,128]; input4 layer element offset; input5 following RMS weight element offset. All tensors contiguous BF16 on the same selected device; offsets must cover the 15730944-element block and 1024-element norm and fit int32 indexing. Relative layout: input norm 0, post-attention norm 1024, QKV 2048, O 4196352, Q/K norms 6293504/6293632, gate/up 6293760, down 12585216. Returns fresh residual[7,1024] and following normalized[7,1024], both captured after the last fused residual_norm kernel. Implementation-specific cut: the following RMS belongs to the next layer for layers 0-26 and to the final model norm for layer 27 (input5=155582464); it is never recomputed. Four projections use the unchanged single-warp mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k16.row.col.f32.bf16.bf16.f32 loop, including the down projection's two 1536-term FP32 split-K partials. Everything else stays single-threaded, retaining four-partial RMS trees, 16 ordered strided attention-dot partials, BF16 rotary/scaling/mask/softmax roundings, the 8-entry descending softmax trees, 4+3 value-GEMM partials, and all residual/SiLU roundings. Rotary is immutable live-through state bound from embedding; original weights/prompt/decode count remain explicit input bindings. No recurrent, convolution or persistent KV state exists in this accepted seven-token prefill; all other workspaces are dead at the cut.

embedding.description: Embedding lookup, RoPE table setup, and first input RMS normalization. Inputs: input0 flat CUDA BF16 packed weights; input1 contiguous CUDA int64[7] prompt with IDs in [0,151936); input2 embedding element offset; input3 RMS weight element offset; input4 first absolute sequence position (0 in this accepted prefill). All tensors share the selected device; offsets must cover a [151936,1024] table and 1024 RMS weights and fit the checked int32 address range. Returns fresh BF16 residual[7,1024], normalized[7,1024], rotary[2,7,128] (cos then sin). One serial thread retains powf/cosf/sinf, the four-partial 128-lane descending RMS tree, epsilon 1e-6 and both BF16 normalization roundings. Rotary explicitly carries all seven positions to every decoder; weights and prompt remain immutable original-input bindings. No hidden or persistent state.

projection.description: Full tied LM-head projection of all seven positions, without argmax or pruning unused score rows. Inputs: input0 contiguous flat CUDA BF16 packed weights; input1 final normalized BF16[7,1024]; input2 LM-head element offset (0 for the tied embedding). Tensors share the selected device; the offset must cover 151936*1024 elements and fit int32 indexing. Returns fresh BF16 logits[7,151936]. Uses the unchanged single-warp native m16n8k16 BF16-to-FP32 MMA loop in increasing K order, then BF16 storage. The final RMS is already included in the preceding decoder's fused residual_norm, not duplicated here. Final hidden is immutable live-through state referenced directly from that decoder as original output 1.
